tagline: The Blues of Loughor, playing rugby since 1882
short: Loughor RFC, the Blues, is a community rugby union club in Loughor, on the River Loughor at the western edge of Swansea, Wales. Founded in 1882, it is a member club of the Welsh Rugby Union, with its ground and clubhouse at Villa Field on Belgrave Road.

colours._note: Taken from the club's crest: royal blue field, gold lettering and edging, green, white and black.

league_note: League names change from season to season; the WRU site has the current table and fixtures.
history: Loughor Rugby Football Club was founded in 1882 in Loughor, the old town on the River Loughor at the western edge of Swansea, where the Romans built the fort of Leucarum and the Normans later raised Loughor Castle. The club plays in royal blue, which gives it its name: the Blues.
Loughor played in the Swansea and District League in its early years, including the 1910-11 season, and became a member club of the Welsh Rugby Union.
The club's best years on the field came in the 1950s, when Loughor won the West Wales Cup in 1952-53 and the West Wales Championship the following season, 1953-54.

Loughor's most famous son in rugby is Ivor Jones, the Wales and British Lions forward. Today the club runs a first XV and second XV in the WRU National Leagues, and a junior section from under 6 to youth, with its home at Villa Field on Belgrave Road.

faq.q: How do I become a member?
faq.a: Ask behind the bar or call 01792 894109. Once the club has added you, sign in to the members' app at member.loughorrfc.site with your email address and the code we send.

faq.q: How do I use my members' discount?
faq.a: Open the Loughor RFC app and hold your phone or watch near the reader, or show your card's QR code at the bar. The discount is applied at the till.
Yes. On the Menu & Order page you can order to your table when you are in the clubhouse, or order for collection and pay at the bar when you collect.

faq.q: Where are the fixtures and results?
faq.a: The current fixtures, results and league table are on the WRU community site, and the club posts match news on its Facebook page and on X (@LoughorRFC).

faq.q: Can I hire the clubhouse for a function?
faq.a: Yes. Call the club on 01792 894109 to check dates and prices.

faq.q: Does the club have junior rugby?
faq.a: Yes, from under 6 up to youth. Call the club to find out when each age group trains this season.

faq.q: Can my business sponsor the club?
faq.a: Yes, the club welcomes sponsors. Call the club on 01792 894109 to talk about kit, match-day and pitch-side sponsorship.
